title: Spirits and Spirit Lords
text: Black Clover Spirit Lords (Salamander, Undine, Sylph, Gnome) are exclusive: one mage per element on the server, called with a Spirit Charm after the Incarnation, one body at a time. Each gives its master an aura (Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Speed and Slow Falling, Resistance). Spirit Dive lets you merge with the spirit. There are also small Tensura-style spirit orbs that follow you, and Spirits of Darkness, Light and Space.
